title: CHINA’S 🇨🇳 CXMT BEGINS MASS PRODUCTION OF FIFTH-GEN DRAM PLATFORM CXMT says the platform reduces key memory-cell spacing to 11.95nm using quadruple patterning, allowing more memory to be packed onto each chip. It also unveiled two new 24-gigabit LPDDR5X chips for smartphones https://t.co/JSx6wYcChH
